subject: NEW DEV PRIORITY: ACP (Agentic Commerce Protocol) integration — from Tima

payload.directive: Tima has designated ACP integration as the team's top development priority. This supersedes current work.
payload.what_is_acp: Agentic Commerce Protocol — open standard by OpenAI + Stripe (Apache-2.0) for AI agents to complete purchases. REST API for checkout sessions, payment delegation via Stripe, capability negotiation. Live in ChatGPT ('Instant Checkout'). Repo: github.com/agentic-commerce-protocol/agentic-commerce-protocol. Specs at v2026-01-30.
payload.why_priority: ACP fills our biggest gap — payment execution. We have identity (L1), values (L2), attribution (L3), communication (L4), governance (L5), but no payment layer. ACP IS that layer. It's backed by OpenAI + Stripe, going to be THE standard for agent commerce. Early integration = credibility + concrete use case for delegation scopes + attribution.

integration_architecture.layer_1_to_acp: Agent Passport provides buyer/seller identity verification for ACP sessions
integration_architecture.layer_3_to_acp: Beneficiary Attribution tracks which human benefits from each purchase — every ACP order becomes a signed ActionReceipt in the Merkle tree
integration_architecture.layer_5_to_acp: Delegation spend limits enforce max purchase amount BEFORE hitting Stripe — delegation says spendLimit:500, ACP checkout for $600 = DENIED at our policy layer
integration_architecture.acp_to_layer_3: Order confirmation from ACP becomes signed ActionReceipt attributed to human principal
integration_architecture.coordination: Operator assigns purchase tasks, Researcher finds best price, Analyst compares, Executor buys via ACP — full coordination primitive chain

deliverables_needed: 1. commerce/ module in agent-passport-system SDK — ACP client that wraps checkout sessions with delegation scope checks
2. ActionReceipt generation for completed ACP orders — links purchase to human beneficiary
4. Values Floor check before purchase execution (F-003 Scoped Authority)
5. Integration RFC for ACP repo discussions — propose Agent Passport as identity layer for ACP
6. Demo: end-to-end agent purchase with passport identity + delegation scope + attribution receipt
prerequisites: Stripe account (Tima to set up or use existing)
Read ACP specs: rfcs/rfc.agentic_checkout.md, rfc.capability_negotiation.md, rfc.payment_handlers.md
payload.strategic_assessment: This is the strongest integration opportunity we've seen. Stronger than AIP (proxy, no response to call request), stronger than Catena (no response at all). ACP solves the 'what can agents DO with passports' question — they can buy things, with cryptographic accountability. The pitch writes itself: 'Our protocol ensures your agent can only spend what you authorized, and every purchase is attributed back to you.'
